## Specific task description

Task instruction: Set the phone with shiny black back on the dark green phonestand.

Task description: Place the phone with the glossy black back on the support area of the dark-green phone stand. The stand is behind and slightly to the right of the phone in the main view.

Success criteria: The phone is placed in the phone-support area of the dark-green stand, close to it in left-right, front-back, and height; both grippers are open and the phone has been released.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping frame sections along the phone's long edges near its intended upper end that accommodate full pads, leaving the lower end free to enter the stand lip. Open slightly wider than the separation between grasp points.
- The phone lies close to the table and has a thin frame. Before closing, confirm the fingers surround opposing frame edges rather than pressing only the upward face or the table. Check for slipping during a small lift before deciding whether to adjust the grasp.
- Adjust the phone tilt in free space in front of the stand. During approach, bring its lower edge above the support lip and gently rest it along the backplate inclination to reduce phone or finger collisions with the lip or backplate.
- Support the phone's lower edge on the lip and rest its body against the back panel before releasing, avoiding an unsupported drop and sliding. Watch finger-to-stand clearance during opening and withdrawal to reduce dragging the phone.
